top_recommendations.why_recommended: Rice is recommended because alkalinity levels are tolerable for root health, available nitrogen is highly adequate for green vegetative growth, cumulative rainfall matches the plant's water consumption footprint.
top_recommendations.agronomic_warning: Rice requires waterlogging conditions (above 1000mm preferred). Verify flood irrigation availability.
top_recommendations.agronomic_reason: Historical farms with similar soil properties cultivated Rice. However, rainfall is below the waterlogging threshold. Consider only under flood irrigation.
action_plan: Plant during the optimal crop season.
Add soil neutralizers like agricultural lime (acidic) or gypsum (alkaline).
Supplement soil Nitrogen using organic manure or nitrogenous urea fertilizers.
Incorporate Single Super Phosphate (SSP) to correct phosphorus deficit.
